# CPU conformance vectors

Generated by `cargo xtask pcemu-vectors --import`; never edit by hand.

Source: the `SingleStepTests` suites, instructions executed on physical
processors, under the MIT licence in `LICENSE` beside this file. Each
`<cpu>.pcv` keeps the first 32 vectors of every upstream file, in file
order, without bus traces: a 32-bit little-endian length, then the
zlib-compressed `tairix_pcemu::vectors` encoding.
